svg.title: Figure 3-2. System FMEA failure chains — sheet 5 of 7 (SFM)
svg.desc: System FMEA failure chains, sheet 5 of 7 (SFM rev 0.31): failure modes SFM-022 to SFM-028 (7 failure modes, 14 causes), each drawn as structure element, function, failure mode with severity, guideword and end effect, and its causes with occurrence, detection, Action Priority and actions.
svg.text: Figure 3-2 · System FMEA failure chains — sheet 5 of 7
SFM rev 0.31 · BL-006 · draft · SFM-022 … SFM-028 · 14 causes on this sheet
FAILURE CAUSE · O · D · AP · ACTIONS (STEPS 4–6)
F5 Driver monitoring: detect inattention and
escalate alerts; lock out engagement after
End effect: Driver not available to handle F1/F2 failures or
DM model false negative (eyes off road classified attentive)
Pose thresholds/calibration wrong for driver or mount
Driver camera or IR illumination degraded
End effect: Driver not ready when takeover needed
Policy timers or recovery factor misconfigured
Low-speed or always-on exemption applied incorrectly
End effect: Driver annoyance; may reduce trust or prompt
Terminal driver-unresponsive state does not bring the item
End effect: No fallback if the driver is incapacitated
F6 Alerting: inform the driver of
Takeover or disengagement alert not presented
End effect: Driver unaware of handback; delayed response
UI process hung or display off
soundd failure or volume too low for cabin noise
UI frame drops or audio buffering
Alert creation_delay or priority hides a more urgent alert
Displayed engagement state differs from actual state
End effect: Driver stops steering/braking believing automation is
active, or is surprised by actuation
Stock dashboard (HUD) state from hudControl inconsistent with item

S = severity of the failure mode (max of its effects); O / D = occurrence / detection of the cause; “in <element>” = structure element where the cause lies; “→” = linked failure mode in another FMEA; hazard = HARA hazard of an end effect.
